rotten_tomatoes_movies.csv must be downloaded from Kaggle and placed here before the movies tutorial can be knitted or run:

  https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/stefanoleone992/rotten-tomatoes-movies-and-critic-reviews-dataset

Download the file named rotten_tomatoes_movies.csv from that dataset page.

Expected columns: id, title, audienceScore, tomatoMeter, rating, ratingContents,
releaseDateTheaters, releaseDateStreaming, runtimeMinutes, genre, originalLanguage,
director, writer, boxOffice, distributor, soundMix
